integrity: The all-length statement is proved by an exact finite-state transfer representation plus an invariant Krylov-space annihilator certificate. Small direct enumerations are corroborative only.
scientific limitations: Binary alphabet and one-deletion radius only; no claim for larger deletion radius, nonbinary alphabets, higher cliques, or a new deletion-code size bound.
title: Exact triangle count in the binary single-deletion graph
